exact: indole acetic acid amide conjugate biosynthesis
indole acetic acid amide conjugate biosynthetic process

definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of an indole-3-acetic acid amide conjugate, a form of indoleacetic acid covalently bound to an amino acid or polypeptide through an amide bond.
